   CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS

  FIRE DEPARTMENT

  MEMORANDUM

TO:  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Public Health Services Ad Hoc Committee

FROM:  Cynthia Owens, Municipal Affairs Program Manager

DATE:  May 5, 2023

SUBJECT:  Discuss Areas the City Council Public Health Services Ad Hoc Committee
  Would Like Staff to Explore

ATTACHMENT:  1. Summary List of Public Health Services the City Provides

INTRODUCTION
On April 4, 2023, Mayor Gold introduced several initiatives during his installation as Mayor
which included Pubic Health Services Coordination. The City Council approved this item being
added to the City Council Priorities for Fiscal Year 2023-2024 (FY 23-24) on April 18, 2023. The
deliverables, as approved by the City Council for FY 23-24 are:
  • Establish a City Council Liaison Committee consisting of Mayor Gold and
  Councilmember Lili Bosse
  • Compile a list of health services the City already provides to its residents (e.g. Nurse
  Practitioner Program)
  • Identify gaps in health services programs offered by City and the needs of the residents
  • Determine financial and structural needs for establishing a Department of Public Health
  Services
  • Determine governing structure to better delivery health services to the community

DISCUSSION
As requested during the April 18 City Council Priorities Setting Session, staff has compiled a list
of public health services currently offered by the City (Attachment 1), which includes but is not
limited to:
  • Nurse Practitioner Program,
  • Step Up on Second,
  • Partners in Care,
  • People Assisting the Homeless (PATH),
  • Paramedics,
  • Mental Health Evaluation Team Clinicians and Officers,
  • Food distribution programs, and
  • Various support group programs.

Staff is still assembling a list of programs offered by Los Angeles County (County) as far as
public health services. This may take time to compile as staff will need to understand exactly
what public health services the County provides and if those services are available to our
residents.
 Staff is requesting guidance from the Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Public Health Services
Ad Hoc Committee (Ad Hoc) for next steps in potentially improving the public health services
offered by the City. This may include items such as:
  • What questions does the Ad Hoc have related to public health services currently
  provided and what could potentially be provided?
  • What areas would the Ad Hoc like researched for the potential expansion of public
  health services provided by the City?
  • Is the Ad Hoc willing to consider hiring a consultant with expertise in the area of public
  health services to help develop a short term and long term plan for expansion of public
  health services?
  • Is the Ad Hoc willing to consider hiring a consultant to assist with a gap analysis?
